note: Brief 018 §5: the run that leaves a standing op mid-fight. Loud (board and go) without the Scout boarding: the blocker is down and the car free, but the officers at their stands are still up, so the Scout, left standing, is captured (fighting: abandoned, resentment +1, loyalty -1) and +4 T goes to the campaign. Brief 098 (Waymark): the Tech regroups at the car (cv-003) when the crew breaks, with the Scout and the Fixer, so the cell boards before the seal.
